metric: Labelled claims about a query's output (column never NULL, columns unique, at most or exactly one row) found by the deterministic analysis; false claims must not be asserted.
caveats: Tuned on test: the development cases (108 queries, two schemas) were used to fix the analysis; the first run proved 83 of 88 on the original 76 queries, and the first held-out set (32 queries) proved 39/41 before it was folded into the development cases when its two misses were fixed. The rollup regression case is now supported (both false claims correctly not asserted). SQLSolver-query results are a separate row.
correctness: 0 wrong; all 69 false labels verified by a violating random database, no true label violated
held_out: 23/23 true claims proved, 0 wrong, 12/12 false labels verified (20 queries, 35 claims, third schema, written before the last two fixes and run once after the analysis was frozen); rerun after the coverage widening: unchanged
